question: Does a new Forever addon-performance troubleshooting product have a concrete opening beyond the completed H4 error-explanation investigation?
scope: Two focused search queries, then direct reads of two Forever player reports and one applicable author-maintained product page
priorWork: H4 already screened fault/settings cases, retrospective prompts and an existing error interpreter. Those checks were read, not rerun.

cases.reportedObservation: One player reports stuttering stopped after lowering Secondary Lighting from High to Good. A separate reply says the same change helped.
cases.classification: Attributed graphics-setting improvement, not reproduced or isolated by this project

cases.reportedObservation: A player previously using a lighting workaround reports that stutters disappeared after a game update without further manual changes.
cases.classification: Reported improvement coinciding with an update; cause and fixed build unverified

applicableAlternative.name: Freeloader
applicableAlternative.advertisedTarget: Forever 1.60.1, plus Classic and Classic TBC
applicableAlternative.advertisedCoverage: Native-profiler CPU display, per-addon worst-frame peak and cumulative spike counts
applicableAlternative.authorDisclosedLimits: Attribution follows owning files/callees; displayed Lua CPU cost excludes rendering cost; window sampling stops while closed
applicableAlternative.evidenceClass: Author description, not our runtime or performance measurement

decision: Park a generic profiler or automatic culprit-finder. The sampled reports do not establish an addon cause, and a Forever-targeted profiler already advertises the obvious measurements. No unmet comparative workflow demonstrated.
reopenWhen: A concrete reproducible Forever incident remains unresolved after the native baseline and an applicable profiler, with an obtainable missing fact or preventable interaction
limits: Purposive sources do not estimate prevalence, market size or willingness to install
Retrieved relative Reddit dates conflict with crawl metadata; no exact event date inferred
Neither player reports nor author descriptions establish current-client compatibility or diagnostic accuracy
No new addon, synthetic benchmark, settings change, installation, recruitment or third-party message performed
